scope_note: Seven linked claims in one source result cluster, not seven independent discoveries. Common fields apply to each entry. Partial semantic inventory only.

common.interpretation: Original current claim, not superseded. Constructed-family cardinality is not complete-fiber cardinality.
common.definitions: Original Lychrel196.step/reverse10/Palindrome and canonical decimal width. Safe n means positive and neither n nor step(n) is palindromic. Full incoming I(w,y) sums every safe n with actual step(n)=y.
common.source_proof: Written all-parameter proof in section 3; computations are supporting evidence only.
common.audit: ../audit/README.md describes the lossless proof-evidence archive and exact later CI artifact. Local clean-family and clean-weights builds plus separate GitHub CI passed; all 51 transitive reports have permitted foundational axioms only.
common.next_action: Independent semantic review and clean rebuild; integrate only through the established owner.

claims.original_mathematical_statement: For every m>=2 and canonical (m-1)-digit A, n_A=A||99||complement(reverse(A)) satisfies step(n_A)=10^(2*m)+99*10^(m-1)-1 and 0<n_A<10^(2*m)<y_m.
claims.quantifiers: forall m>=2, forall canonical A of width m-1
claims.hypotheses_and_exceptions: Natural positive seeds, exact width, low complemented block retains zeros, original total iteration map.
claims.exact_coverage: Full original claim, no strengthened premises

claims.original_mathematical_statement: For every m>=2, each displayed n_A and y_m belongs to S: positive and nonpalindromic now and after one actual step.
claims.quantifiers: forall m>=2, forall canonical A of width m-1
claims.hypotheses_and_exceptions: Exact canonical widths; no zero seed or dropped low positions

claims.original_mathematical_statement: The constructed family has exactly 9*10^(m-2) distinct members; explicit finite indexing is injective and covers all canonical high words.
claims.quantifiers: forall m>=2; indexing of the constructed family, not the entire inverse fiber
claims.hypotheses_and_exceptions: Leading digit nonzero; all remaining high digits allowed, zero positions retained
claims.exact_coverage: Exact indexing and completeness, not only a noninjective list

claims.original_mathematical_statement: For every natural N there exists a safe target with N distinct positive safe predecessors below it.
claims.quantifiers: forall N, exists safe y, exists injective f:Fin N -> Nat, forall i, Safe(f i) and step(f i)=y and f i<y
claims.hypotheses_and_exceptions: N=0 is included; no extra target premise
claims.exact_coverage: Deduced corollary of the original family, not separately claimed original discovery

claims.original_mathematical_statement: For every real weight positive and nonincreasing on S, and every m>=2, I(w,y_m)/w(y_m) >= 9*10^(m-2).
claims.quantifiers: forall w:Nat->Real positive and antitone on S, forall m>=2
claims.hypotheses_and_exceptions: No restrictions on w outside S; denominator proved positive; I includes the complete actual safe fiber
claims.exact_coverage: Full real-valued source statement and independent full-fiber encoding bridge

claims.original_mathematical_statement: No finite real C satisfies I(w,y)<=C*w(y) at every safe y for a positive weight nonincreasing on S.
claims.quantifiers: forall eligible w, forall real C, exists safe y with C*w(y)<I(w,y)
claims.hypotheses_and_exceptions: No C>=0 premise; w outside S unrestricted; genuine full safe incoming sum
claims.exact_coverage: Full original obstruction, both strict witness and negated-existence forms

claims.original_mathematical_statement: For every eligible real weight and every m>=2, (9/100)*sqrt(10/11)*sqrt(y_m) < I(w,y_m)/w(y_m).
claims.quantifiers: forall eligible real w, forall m>=2
claims.hypotheses_and_exceptions: Exact real constants and strict inequality; no floating-point approximation
claims.exact_coverage: Full original strict quantitative lower bound
